fit_reason: Whole 1993 Eroca pontoon boat listed by a private owner in boats by owner.
findings: Dull, slightly chalky look on the aluminum toons and side skirts visible from the stern and port side
Off-white vinyl seats look dingy with grayish soiling, especially on the bow lounge cushions and backrests
Light dirt and debris scattered on the gray deck carpet near the stern and bow
Loose rope and gear piled on the deck at the stern corner, making the deck look cluttered
Weathered, dull finish on the hard top Bimini panel shown on the trailer
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Eroca Captain Deluxe pontoon. The off-white seat vinyl looks like it would brighten up a lot with a good cleaning, and the deck carpet and toons could use a refresh before buyers see it. We do mobile pre-sale details and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
